regime.label: Fearful, no panic
regime.summary: Tue 14:30 ET: S&P 500 -1.2% (7,327), Dow -1.6%, Nasdaq -1.1%, every sector down; VIX about 26. Stoxx 600 closed -1.75%, its worst day in eight months. A December Fed hike is about 95% priced. VIX under 30: no panic selling of long-term holdings.

brief: US stocks fall for a fourth day before Nvidia's results tonight (S&P 500 -1.2% at 14:30 ET, VIX near 26); Europe had its worst day in eight months. Today: no new buy; keep the CBRS $100 stop on the close and the Richemont CHF 170 limit, and act on Nvidia only Wed after 19:00 Dubai.

todo.focus: Day after Nvidia + Anthropic prices tonight. Read, then act.

items.text: Nvidia: check its move after the results, then follow the plan on its card
Infineon: BUY 10 IFX at EUR 48.50 max if above EUR 46
TSMC: BUY 1 TSM only if it closes above $385; limit at that close or $395, if lower
Eaton: BUY 1 ETN, limit $335 or Tue close if lower, only if ETN is above $327 after Nvidia

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at CHF 170, valid until Fri Nov 27. Closed about CHF 172.95 Tue. Keep the limit, do not chase. SIX, or ADR CFRUY.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia results Tue (call 02:00 Dubai Wed)
cards.trigger: HOLD. No new AI buy before the numbers. Act Wed after 19:00 Dubai using the playbook. Never decide in the first 30 minutes.
cards.story: A big move is the most likely outcome; only its direction is unknown. The risk is the reaction: high expectations, new CEO, guidance.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: WAIT for Nvidia results. From Wed Nov 18: BUY 6 with a limit at $87.00 or Tuesday's close, whichever is lower, valid until Fri Nov 20. Then 6 more weekly below $91.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. 3.5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit likely filled Monday (closed $283.72). If not filled, it stays valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. Fell 12.6% on Oct 29, partly from a one-off investment loss.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: About $360.54 Tue, under the $385 floor. From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 only if TSM closes above $385, limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 10 with a limit at EUR 48.50 if IFX holds above EUR 46. Closed EUR 48.69 Tue. ASML: no order while under EUR 1,250.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips. Growth leans on one segment and the cash flow guide was soft.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 with a limit at $335 or Tuesday's close, whichever is lower, only if ETN holds above $327. Now $334.63.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), guidance raised, but debt doubled and data-center policy risk is real.

cards.name: Global Payments
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $86, valid until Fri Nov 20. Now $87.27 (Tue 14:12 ET).
cards.story: -12% when buyout talks ended: buyers could not finance a deal. Cheap at about 6.5x profit, so buy only lower.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT for a dip: BUY 2 with a limit at EUR 235 (closed EUR 236.60 Tue). Paris hours 12:00-20:30 Dubai, or US OTC SBGSY.
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal and a Middle East warning, not demand.

cards.name: Deutsche Bank
cards.trigger: WATCH only. No buy before Mon Nov 23. Then reconsider only if no regulator (BaFin, ECB, DOJ) opens a new probe.
cards.story: About -5% after a leak of 15 million old files. Profits untouched, but fines or probes could follow.

cards.name: Indra · Madrid
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Indra's strategic plan on Wed Nov 25. Reconsider only if no charge is filed and no contract is reopened. Now EUR 54.00.
cards.story: -6.4% on a probe into Spanish defence contracts. Revenue +29%, backlog about EUR 22bn, but the probe is still open.

cards.name: Luxury selloff: Hermes, Kering, Moncler
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy on Hermes, Kering or Moncler. Hermes: only if China sales stop falling (Feb 2027). Kering: only if Gucci stops shrinking.
cards.story: Hermes -5.1%, Moncler about -4.5%, Kering -3.5% Tue. Hermes still about 29x profit for about 10% growth.

cards.name: Micron (memory chips)
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy: AI-chip theme. Reconsider only after Nvidia's results and Micron's own report (about Dec 16).
cards.story: About -20% in a month. Next quarter guided $61.5B, but price rises will slow and a DRAM price-fixing lawsuit goes ahead.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Salesforce results Wed Dec 2. From Fri Dec 4: reconsider 2 CRM below $215 if organic growth holds and no guide is cut.
cards.story: Salesforce about -8%, SAP -5.6%, Dassault -4.9% Tue. Without acquisitions Salesforce grows only about 6-7%.
